jobs.excerpt: Student Intern, Administration & Communications, California Education Learning Lab100% Remote within California, Must reside in California Join an equity-focused, collaborative team seeking to foster innovation in college teaching and learning practices through competitive grant-making, in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math (STEM) and other disciplines.
jobs.description:
Student Intern, Administration & Communications, California Education Learning Lab

100% Remote within California, Must reside in California


Join an equity-focused, collaborative team seeking to foster innovation in college teaching and learning practices through competitive grant-making, in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math (STEM) and other disciplines.

The California Education Learning Lab (Learning Lab) is a state-funded grantmaking program charged with improving learning outcomes and closing equity gaps across California’s public higher education. Learning Lab supports innovation in higher education pedagogy through intersegmental grants to California’s public colleges and universities. Funded projects leverage technology tools and the science of human learning to create better online and hybrid learning environments and empower faculty in their teaching mission to find solutions that work best for California’s diverse student population.


What You’ll Do


The Student Intern is a part-time, paid position that will support a dynamic team to help develop education-focused communications, such as promotional materials and social media content, that is mission- and brand-aligned, and to handle general administrative tasks. Depending on the interests and skills of the successful candidate, this position may provide opportunities for unique writing, media research, website, and/or AI/technology-related projects.

jobs.title: Remote  Business Financial Systems Cloud FinOps
jobs.excerpt: Remote Business Financial Systems Cloud FinOps needs experience in financial systems, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
jobs.description:
Remote Business Financial Systems Cloud FinOps needs experience in financial systems, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.

Remote Business Financial Systems Cloud FinOps requires:

Experience with process improvement.

Experience with cloud financial operations (FinOps) and cloud cost management

Proficient in Microsoft Access, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Strong database reporting skills utilizing Access, Cognos, and data warehouse tools

Strong analytical, technical, and decision-making skills.

Project management skills and ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

Proficiency in cloud financial management tools and practices.

Remote Business Financial Systems Cloud FinOps duties:

Provide analytical support for various systems configurations and financial processes.

Develop and implement Cloud FinOps processes to optimize cloud costs and improve financial efficiency.

Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external business partners.

Perform root cause analysis through research and data analysis to determine efficient and customer-valued solutions.

Design, track, and provide solutions to management for various processes reporting, including productivity, quality, and systems.
